title: IndoorSnapshot
description: indoor.json of a published map version, schema_version 1 (docs/snapshot-format.md): the indoor map as IMDF-like GeoJSON features: venues, levels, spaces, nodes, edges, POIs and street connectors. Public: it holds only what clients need for display and routing, never anchors, restricted zones, permissions, contributors, change sets, captures, private URIs or revs. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: at most 7 decimals in coordinates, latitudes within -90 to 90, closed rings, feature ids unique and equal to properties.id, references resolve within the file (level venue_id, the level_id of spaces, nodes and POIs, edge from_node and to_node, POI space_id, connector node_id), an edge's line starts exactly at from_node and ends exactly at to_node, a connector's line starts exactly at its node, at most one connector per node, each connector's id derived from its node_id, and features sorted by type in the order venue, level, space, node, edge, poi, street_connector, then by id.

features.description: Every feature, sorted by type, then by id. At most 100000.

feature.title: IndoorFeature
feature.description: One feature of indoor.json; properties.feature_type says which kind.

venue.title: VenueFeature
venue.description: A venue (venues): a mall, MRT station or link, with its footprint.

geometry.description: venues.footprint, or null when HEAD has none.

venueProperties.title: VenueProperties
venueProperties.description: What clients need of a venue.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

name.description: The venue's name, for example Funan.

level.title: LevelFeature
level.description: A level (levels) of a venue. Levels have no geometry. The level switcher groups levels by ordinal band and orders them by sort_key within a band.

geometry.description: Always null: levels have no outline.

levelProperties.title: LevelProperties
levelProperties.description: What clients need of a level.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

venue_id.description: The venue the level belongs to.

name.description: The name as the venue signs it, for example "B2".

sort_key.description: Orders levels of one venue that share a band.

elevation_m.description: Floor height in metres relative to the height datum, or null until measured.

space.title: SpaceFeature
space.description: A space (spaces): a walkable or named area on one level.

spaceProperties.title: SpaceProperties
spaceProperties.description: What clients need of a space.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

ordinal.description: The band of the space's level (levels.ordinal), for the level filter.

name.description: The name as signed, or null.

node.title: NodeFeature
node.description: A node (nodes) of the indoor routing graph: a junction, exit, entrance, door, fare gate, or one landing of a vertical connector.

id.description: nodes.id. Status reports (status.json) key nodes by it.

nodeProperties.title: NodeProperties
nodeProperties.description: What clients need of a node.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

level_id.description: The node's level, or null for a node outside any venue (a street exit).

ordinal.description: The band of the node's level, 0 without a level (nodes.ordinal).

name.description: The name as signed, for example Exit A, or null.

street_name.description: For an exit or entrance: the street or building it opens onto, used as its label. Null otherwise.

connector_id.description: Groups the landings of one physical escalator, lift, stairs, travelator or ramp; null for other nodes.

edge.title: EdgeFeature
edge.description: An edge (edges) of the indoor routing graph. A vertical connector (escalator, stairs, lift, ramp, travelator) joins landings on different levels, has level_id null and is drawn on both end bands.

id.description: edges.id. Status reports (status.json) key edges by it.

geometry.description: edges.geom, or a straight line from from_node to to_node when HEAD has none. Runs from from_node to to_node: its first position is exactly from_node's and its last exactly to_node's, so a route drawn edge by edge has no gaps.

edgeProperties.title: EdgeProperties
edgeProperties.description: What clients need of an edge: its endpoints and the routing attributes (docs/decisions/0003-routing.md).

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

from_node.description: The node the edge starts at.

to_node.description: The node the edge ends at.

from_ordinal.description: The band of from_node, for the level filter.

to_ordinal.description: The band of to_node, for the level filter. Differs from from_ordinal only on a connector between bands.

level_id.description: The edge's level, or null for a vertical connector.

connector_id.description: The physical connector the edge belongs to, or null.

oneway.description: true: traversable only from from_node to to_node.

opening_hours.description: When the edge is open; null means always open. An exit's hours are on the edges leading to it.

length_m.description: Length in metres, measured in SVY21, rounded to 2 decimals.

step_free.description: Usable without steps; never true for stairs and escalators.

outdoor.description: Outdoors; drawn dashed, and avoided when "stay underground" is on.

poi.title: PoiFeature
poi.description: A point of interest (pois): a shop, toilet, ATM and so on.

poiProperties.title: PoiProperties
poiProperties.description: What clients need of a POI.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

ordinal.description: The band of the POI's level, for the level filter.

space_id.description: The space the POI is in, or null.

streetConnector.title: StreetConnectorFeature
streetConnector.description: A street connector (street_connectors): joins an exit or entrance node to the nearest vertex of the street graph in street.json. Derived and rebuilt in every publish, keyed by its node: an exit or entrance has at most one, and its id is derived from node_id, so it stays the same from version to version.

id.description: The UUIDv5 of node_id (as lowercase text) in the namespace 1ffdedde-dd2f-4f6d-a18a-800669a179e1 (docs/snapshot-format.md). street_connectors has no id of its own.

geometry.description: street_connectors.geom: from the node to the street vertex, starting exactly at the node's position and ending exactly at the street node's.

streetConnectorProperties.title: StreetConnectorProperties
streetConnectorProperties.description: What clients need of a street connector.

feature_type.description: The feature type (IMDF's feature_type, inside properties so that map style filters can read it).

id.description: The feature's id again: MapLibre identifies a GeoJSON feature only by a numeric id or by a property it promotes (promoteId), so renderers read this one.

osm_node_id.description: The street vertex: a street_node feature's id in street.json.

ordinal.description: The band of the node, for the level filter.

length_m.description: Length in metres, measured in SVY21, rounded to 2 decimals.
